answer: Enrollment needs a vendor-signed attestation from the handset's secure element, keyed to that epoch's public beacon so a replayed certificate fails. The device serial binds to one wallet, and a duplicate serial folds both into a single vote. Every sixth epoch the element re-signs a fresh nonce, which retires rented handsets within about a month. A thousand clones means a thousand phones at $180 plus $12 of monthly service, near $192,000 sunk before one payout clears. A vine throws many runners, but each must root in its own soil; painted ledges will not hold a climber's weight.
